title: Add docs/ontology.toml with sourced terms, validating test, decision
summary: Retry of job 20261017-173508-0wtc: add a small ontology file with the seven seeded misread terms, each with per-term sources, a Rust structural test, and a decision entry. Hermes now covers both senses (Hermes Agent and the Olympus Orchestration god), and relations match Olympus. No per-occurrence BRIEF.md cross-check, per the user's reply.

defaults_applied.how: New Rust test with negative unit cases; cargo test, clippy, fmt --check pass.
Test run shows the real file passes and bad in-memory inputs fail.
No email or personal data in new files.
One focused change; dropped per-occurrence cross-check and the optional docs/ontology.md and xtask test.
Terms defined for outside readers with sources.
Every term and every 'not part of' claim cites a source.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Audience: agents that read the file, checks that parse it, and Sri judging it.
The system is Olympus; Athena is its strategy and learning role; Sri is the owner (Zeus) of Olympus.
Test lives in crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs and parses docs/ontology.toml with the toml crate already available or added; negative cases run on in-memory input.
The Hermes term was searched for in BRIEF.md by the producer to find its senses (Pantheon table, Part 2 S1), but this search is not recorded or tested.
docs/decision-links.toml needs an entry for the new decision if the repo requires one.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/ontology.toml defines the seven terms (planning, job, Athena, Hermes, product versus system, landed, Sri). Each has a definition, the misread that caused it, a sources field naming paths or decision ids that exist, and relations whose targets are all defined terms.

The Hermes entry names both senses: Hermes Agent (second studied system, Part 2 S1, not part of Athena) and Hermes as the Orchestration god in the Olympus Pantheon (BRIEF.md). It says which is part of Olympus and cites a source for each. Every 'not part of' claim has a source.
Relations match Olympus: the system is Olympus, Athena is the strategy and learning role within it, Sri owns Olympus (Zeus). No relation makes Athena the whole system.

The file states a term is added only when it causes a misread and says how a check reads it (parse path and fields). Landed means merged on main through a verified pull request. The Sri term says use the name or 'they', never he or she, and cites job 20261017-173504-91ys.

docs/decisions.md has a new entry keeping the ontology, citing the Olympus 2026-10-17 decision sheet (decision 5), listing alternatives (no ontology; per-study glossaries only), and stating studies keep their own concept model so firstmate, Hermes Agent and Athena are compared in the same terms. docs/decision-links.toml is updated if required, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Run `cargo test`: the new ontology test passes on docs/ontology.toml, and in-memory unit tests show failure for a missing sources field, a non-existent source, a dangling relation target, and a duplicate term. `cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
No secrets or personal data, including the user's email address, appear in any new or changed file.

out_of_scope: Recording or testing every occurrence of a term name in BRIEF.md
Changing studies or their concept models
